lines.description: Between 1 and 50 lines; an outcome with more is `422 validation-failed`.

ownerRef.description: The stock owner the quantities belong to; omitted for operator-owned stock.

qtyRestockable.description: Graded units that may be restocked, 0 to 2147483647 (a larger value is `422 validation-failed`).

qtyUnsellable.description: Graded units that may not, 0 to 2147483647 (a larger value is `422 validation-failed`).
